name: Luwu Compiler Remarks
comment: The compiler remarks view: the source, with a `-- remark: ...` comment above each line the compiler has remarks for (BytecodeBuilder::dumpSourceRemarks in luwu's Bytecode/src/BytecodeBuilder.cpp)

load-remark-text.comment: Never matches. vscode-textmate only loads the grammars that ordinary patterns include, not those included from captures, so this makes it load source.luwu-bytecode for #remark-comment.
